\subsubsection{\texttt{case-index}: Case index}
\label{sec:contract-case-index}

Catalog row case-index 1.0.0: the inventory of cases the site serves (data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak manifests/\allowbreak index.\allowbreak json).\allowbreak  The contract carries schema 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak pipeline/\allowbreak pipeline/\allowbreak core/\allowbreak manifest.\allowbreak py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak schemas/\allowbreak common/\allowbreak case-\allowbreak index.\allowbreak schema.\allowbreak json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak manifests/\allowbreak index.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_documents.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_index\allowbreak \_validates}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak src/\allowbreak lib/\allowbreak contract.\allowbreak test.\allowbreak ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: missing: copy-data stops the site build (no site without an inventory); at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak Error (an HTTP status or a non-JSON answer); a view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, and the C04 result sections show a LoadError alert (data-state error), never an empty chart. stale: engine\allowbreak \_version differs from VERSION (the index records the engine that baked it). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak manifests/\allowbreak index.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_documents.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_every\allowbreak \_document\allowbreak \_matches\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_validates}. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak fixtures/\allowbreak c09/\allowbreak models-\allowbreak fixture.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts\allowbreak \_u6/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_u6\allowbreak \_contracts.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_fixture\allowbreak \_exists\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_discovered\allowbreak \_by\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema}. test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_fixture\allowbreak \_exists\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_discovered\allowbreak \_by\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C15 models artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak Error; the C15 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason in the document, never a number (a dash of the Annex 1 Hoja 9 table is null; a margin volatility the fit lacks is null with its reason). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak fixtures/\allowbreak c15/\allowbreak models-\allowbreak fixture.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts\allowbreak \_u10/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_u10\allowbreak \_contracts.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_fixture\allowbreak \_exists\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_discovered\allowbreak \_by\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema}. test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_fixture\allowbreak \_exists\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_discovered\allowbreak \_by\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C18 scenario artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak Error; the view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A source absent at bake time leaves its variant unwritten (the NGFS variant waits for the IIASA read, the EBA variant for its workbook; an absent Fed table or a missing C07, C15 or C17 document stops C18 whole); the schemas carry no zero or neutral stand-in. The cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot state are tests/\allowbreak contracts\allowbreak \_u13/\allowbreak semantics.\allowbreak py violations(doc), which the bake runs over every document it writes. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak fixtures/\allowbreak c18/\allowbreak variant-\allowbreak scenario-\allowbreak fed-\allowbreak 2026-\allowbreak severely-\allowbreak adverse-\allowbreak fixture.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts\allowbreak \_u13/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_u13\allowbreak \_contracts.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_fixture\allowbreak \_exists\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_discovered\allowbreak \_by\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema}. The test ids, the families (variants) and the panels are closed enums; the simulations of the engine's named studies carry a study block, every other simulation a null one. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak pipeline/\allowbreak pipeline/\allowbreak cases/\allowbreak c22\allowbreak \_validator.\allowbreak py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak schemas/\allowbreak c22/\allowbreak variant.\allowbreak schema.\allowbreak json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak C22/\allowbreak *.\allowbreak json, !data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak C22/\allowbreak models-\allowbreak generators.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_documents.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_variants\allowbreak \_validate}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_c22\allowbreak \_all\allowbreak \_families.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_schema\allowbreak \_refuses\allowbreak \_an\allowbreak \_unknown\allowbreak \_test\allowbreak \_id\allowbreak \_family\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_study}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak c22\allowbreak \_sequential/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_sequential\allowbreak \_c22.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_committed\allowbreak \_block\allowbreak \_is\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_run\allowbreak \_of\allowbreak \_2000\allowbreak \_series\allowbreak \_per\allowbreak \_scenario\allowbreak \_on\allowbreak \_the\allowbreak \_engine\allowbreak \_1\allowbreak \_1\allowbreak \_0}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak src/\allowbreak lib/\allowbreak contract.\allowbreak test.\allowbreak ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: an artifact a manifest names is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak Error (an HTTP status or a non-JSON answer); a view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, and the C04 result sections show a LoadError alert (data-state error), never an empty chart. The other variants and cases keep working. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/\allowbreak derived/\allowbreak C22/\allowbreak null.\allowbreak json.\allowbreak  The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak contracts/\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_documents.\allowbreak py::\allowbreak test\allowbreak \_every\allowbreak \_document\allowbreak \_matches\allowbreak \_exactly\allowbreak \_one\allowbreak \_schema\allowbreak \_and\allowbreak \_validates}. \subsubsection{\texttt{c22-models}: C22 models}
